## Added

- **Settings window** — paste a manual auth token override (auto-saved as you type, useful when the Claude Code token expires or to avoid repeated Keychain prompts), configurable refresh interval (30s–30min), and a "launch at login" toggle (`SMAppService`).
- **Menu bar icon as a progress pill** — shows the consumed amount centered on a color-coded bar (green / orange / red) instead of plain text.
- **Gradient credit bar** — the popover's consumption bar now blends green → orange → red across the 50%/80% thresholds instead of jumping between flat colors.
- **5h / 7-day rate-limit windows** displayed in the popover (previously fetched but unused).
- **Host Grotesk** typeface and a 3-section popover layout (title / consumption / settings-quit), each following light/dark mode.
- CI: `test.yml` (build + `swift test` on a macOS runner, every push/PR) and `release.yml` (tag `vX.Y.Z` → signed `.app`, `.dmg`, GitHub Release, Homebrew cask bump).

## Fixed

- **Keychain token parsing** — the access token is nested under `claudeAiOauth.accessToken` in Claude Code's stored credentials, not at the top level; the app never authenticated before this fix.
- **Menu bar icon showing no color** — `MenuBarExtra`'s `label:` is hosted by `NSStatusItem.button`, which silently ignores custom Shape fills and font modifiers (confirmed via Apple Developer Forums). The pill is now pre-rendered to an `NSImage` via `ImageRenderer` instead of passed as a live SwiftUI view.
- **"Unable to update Font Descriptor's weight" console warning** — chaining `.fontWeight()` on a custom static font is unreliable; each weight now references its own `.ttf` by exact PostScript name.
- **Settings window not appearing** — `.accessory` apps (no Dock icon) never become frontmost automatically; `openWindow()` now pairs with `NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps:)`.
- **Illegible buttons in dark mode** — the title/bottom section backgrounds used a fixed `Color.gray` that didn't darken; switched to adaptive `Color.primary.opacity()`.
- **Progress bar losing its color** — `ProgressView().tint()` wasn't reliably applied in this context; replaced by a custom Shape-based bar (also the fix that enabled the gradient above).

## Known limitations

- Not notarized (no Apple Developer Program account) — first launch needs a right-click → Open, or `xattr -cr`.
- No reset date shown for the monthly credit limit: Anthropic's `/api/oauth/usage` doesn't expose one for `extra_usage` (confirmed) — only the Admin API (different credential entirely) has billing-cycle data.
- No OAuth refresh-token flow: when the Claude Code token expires, re-run `claude login` or paste a fresh token in Settings.
